name: Taunggyi

queries.query: Taunggyi Myanmar official cadastral map parcel land records GIS Survey Department
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Myanmar Survey Department, the Shan State Government, and an official Taunggyi Township profile. Official sources confirm Taunggyi land administration context, but no anonymous parcel viewer/API or ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

မြန်မာဘာသာဖြင့် ပထမပါတီရှာဖွေမှုတွင် တောင်ကြီးမြို့နယ် မြေဧရိယာ/မြို့မြေစာရင်းဆိုင်ရာ အချက်အလက်များနှင့် တောင်ကြီးခရိုင် လယ်ယာမြေစီမံခန့်ခွဲရေးနှင့် စာရင်းအင်းဦးစီးဌာန ကိုးကားချက်ကို တွေ့ရှိခဲ့သည်။ အမည်ခံ parcel ID နှင့် geometry ပါသော အများပြည်သူသုံး API/viewer မတွေ့ရှိခဲ့ပါ။

registryEvidence.custodian: Myanmar Survey Department, with a Taunggyi District Land Management and Statistics office evidenced in an official Myanmar Gazette record; Shan State Investment Committee also publishes an official Taunggyi Township land-area profile.
registryEvidence.basis: The official gazette search result names တောင်ကြီးခရိုင် လယ်ယာမြေစီမံခန့်ခွဲရေးနှင့် စာရင်းအင်းဦးစီးဌာန (Taunggyi District Land Management and Statistics Department). The official SSIC Taunggyi profile reports city land and other land-area categories. This establishes local land-record custodial context, not an open digital parcel feed.

requests.outcome: Official Survey Department route identified in first-party discovery. Direct HTTPS and HTTP retrievals timed out after bounded attempts; no HTML, JavaScript, viewer configuration, API, schema, or CRS was recovered. No TLS verification bypass was used.
HTTP 200 official Taunggyi Township profile. It reports total land area and categories including City Land, but contains no parcel polygons, stable parcel IDs, viewer configuration, schema, or CRS.
Official Burmese Taunggyi Township page was returned in first-party search evidence; it reports land-area categories in Burmese and exposes no public parcel geometry service.

Official Myanmar Gazette search evidence names the Taunggyi District Land Management and Statistics Department. This is custodian/procedure evidence only; no parcel geometry was requested or retained.
Official national portal page confirms Shan State/Taunggyi administrative context; no cadastral viewer or parcel API exposed.

schemaCrs.details: No anonymous parcel response was obtained, so native field schema, stable parcel identity field, geometry encoding, source CRS, and citywide extent could not be verified.

geometryReview.reason: No safe anonymous native parcel ID plus full polygon response was exposed by the official routes inspected.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [20.7812120589556, 97.0287752632216] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted to force a parcel hit.
The local district land-management office and official Taunggyi land profile evidence a custodian and land-record context, not a verified open digital parcel layer.
The Survey Department host timed out; this access limitation is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No exact-point hit/miss, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI was treated as citywide absence.
No owner/right-holder, address/contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, transaction, or application fields were requested or retained.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native ID plus full parcel polygon was verified.
This packet is research evidence only; source integration/admission was not performed and runtime readiness remains held.
uncertainty: Medium-high: a Taunggyi local land-record custodian is first-party evidenced, but public parcel coverage, current viewer/API routes, safe native identity fields, schema, CRS, and citywide coverage remain unknown.
